[element-given-names]
=== `<given-names>` Given (First) Names

All given names of a person, such as the first name, middle names, maiden name if used as part of the married name, etc.

#### Usage/Remarks
As a typical example, in the name “John Q. Delancey Public”, the <<element-given-names,`<given-names>`>> would be “John Q. Delancey” and the <<element-surname,`<surname>`>> would be “Public”.
